en: Color view over a lakeside town backed by high mountains. In the foreground is a waterfront promenade lined with lush greenery and palm trees, separated from the road above by a wall. Across the blue water lies a dense row of old buildings with red-tiled roofs and pastel facades. A notable feature is a square stone bell tower rising above an arcaded white building near the center. There are traffic signs visible on the left side of the road, and the overall style suggests a mid‑20th‑century tourist postcard.
